experimental_interpretation.vortex_hypothesis: V24.15 localized Scully surface retained; V24.16 tests whether continuous stirring creates a size-resolved sediment field that changes optical transport
experimental_interpretation.delta_h_definition: wall surface height minus centre surface height
experimental_interpretation.equivalent_rotation_relation: Omega_c=sqrt(2*g*Hinf/a^2); equivalent core rpm is a geometry diagnostic, not a measured stirrer speed
experimental_interpretation.particle_state: frozen q=1.0 isotropic morphology, 25 deg RMS slope, 100 nm wave height; nominal PSD/concentration; no aggregation or fragmentation
experimental_interpretation.core_radius_definition: a is the Scully vortex core radius; it controls localization independently of wall-centre depth
experimental_interpretation.eddy_diffusion_interpretation: single scalar D_t represents unresolved radial/vertical turbulent mixing and recirculation; it is a transport parameter, not an optical multiplier
experimental_interpretation.mass_conservation: each PSD bin independently volume-normalised over the actual curved cell
experimental_interpretation.optical_sampling: CUDA Woodcock/delta tracking with exact per-bin density majorant and local event-bin sampling
experimental_interpretation.scope_limit: Stokes slip + scalar eddy diffusivity first closure; no finite-Re drag or CFD recirculation field in V24.16

geometry_provenance.paper_conflict_note: Section 5.3 prose states 3 mm through / 10 mm depth; Fig.3, Fig.4 machining caption and Fig.6 state 4 mm through / 8 mm depth. V24.4 defaults to drawing/machining values.
geometry_provenance.photodiode_active_area_note: Not specified in the supplied paper; no invented active-area aperture is imposed.
geometry_provenance.source_launch_note: The paper defines the ring bore but does not locate the LED die/luminous plane within the module. V24.4 defaults the launch reference to the ring outer face and exposes it as a configurable parameter.
geometry_provenance.bottom_disc_note: Paper BOM/sample-cell description specifies a 3-mm clear acrylic disc glued to the tube bottom.
geometry_provenance.source_beta_note: Historical CLARITAS beam-divergence prior chosen manually in thesis section 5.2.3; used as a DGB audit prior, not treated as a measured LED datasheet law.
geometry_provenance.source_launch_audit_note: LED luminous plane is not dimensioned in the paper. Audit spans the 8-mm counterbore from its inner shoulder to the ring outer face.

detector_estimator.selected_geometry: 4-mm diameter through-bore from r=50.5 to57.5 mm; 8.7-mm counterbore from57.5 to65.5 mm
detector_estimator.legacy_comparison: original CLARITAS +/-6.5-degree boundary exit-position scorer; overlapping channels; not selected

sampling_guidance.note: Screen the 4x4 localized geometry grid first, plus one exact flat baseline. Primary ranking uses unweighted mean RMSE across 0.5, 2 and 4 g/L; H170, H170/H160, sector balance, top-surface interactions and TIR are reported separately. Raise TARGET_SCORE to 300 for shortlisted production cases.

particle_optics_v24_5.surface_reflectance: unpolarised Fresnel reflectance using complex n(d)+i*k(d)
particle_optics_v24_5.particle_encounter_cross_section: geometric pi*r^2 retained deliberately from V24.4 in this first attempt
particle_optics_v24_5.profile_status: exploratory hypothesis; not measured optical constants for these samples
particle_optics_v24_5.loess_profile_concept: fine fraction increasingly clay/iron-rich; coarse fraction increasingly quartz/feldspar-rich, mixed by complex Lorentz-Lorenz
particle_optics_v24_5.kaolin_profile_concept: conservative clay-dominant explicit profile; secondary to first loess diagnostic

apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.purpose: Correct the 622-nm steady-state DGB apparatus geometry before further sediment-physics changes.
new_cuda_physics: finite acrylic bottom-disc slab with repeated Fresnel/TIR
apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.dgb_constraint: Thesis Figure 4-3 water-only calibrated radiant-intensity ratio H10/H0 ~= 0.169807 from vector chart extraction.
apparatus_fix_v24_10_1.sediment_physics: Frozen from V24.10 during DGB audit.

apparatus_fix_v24_14.purpose: Test the thesis-documented stirred vortex as a fixed apparatus optical mechanism for the persistent 170-degree lobe.
new_cuda_physics: exact ray intersection with volume-preserving parabolic water-air free surface
water-air Fresnel reflection/TIR at local incidence angle
repeated reflected/TIR water-side encounters with curved surface
apparatus_fix_v24_14.headspace_scope: rays transmitted into air through the top are counted as top exits, retaining the established V24.10.1 treatment; air-headspace re-entry is outside this first diagnostic
apparatus_fix_v24_14.sediment_physics: Frozen reference morphology q=1, slope=25 deg, wave height=100 nm, isotropic; no population evolution.

apparatus_fix_v24_15.purpose: Replace the V24.14 full-radius rigid-body paraboloid with a localized, volume-preserving Scully-type vortex free surface motivated by the TARDIIS photograph.
new_cuda_physics: localized Scully-type free-surface height with independent core radius and wall-centre depth
exact rational-surface ray interception through a CUDA cubic solver
water-air Fresnel reflection/TIR at the local incidence angle
repeated reflected/TIR water-side encounters with the localized curved surface
apparatus_fix_v24_15.legacy_comparison: V24.14 parabolic_vortex remains selectable for A/B regression; delta_h=0 retains the exact historical flat branch.
apparatus_fix_v24_15.headspace_scope: rays transmitted into air through the top are counted as top exits; air-headspace re-entry remains outside this diagnostic
apparatus_fix_v24_15.sediment_physics: Frozen reference morphology q=1, slope=25 deg, wave height=100 nm, isotropic; nominal PSD/concentration; no aggregation, fragmentation, settling, or spatial concentration field.

sediment_transport_v24_16.purpose: Test whether size-dependent sediment redistribution generated by the continuously stirred Scully vortex can explain the remaining TARDIIS angular-response discrepancy without empirical optical multipliers.
sediment_transport_v24_16.mixing_closure: scalar effective eddy diffusivity D_t applied to radial and vertical particle transport
sediment_transport_v24_16.steady_field: zero-flux drift-diffusion with independent curved-vessel volume normalization for every PSD bin
sediment_transport_v24_16.optical_transport: CUDA Woodcock/delta tracking with exact per-bin density maxima and local event-bin sampling
sediment_transport_v24_16.mass_conservation: integrated number and mass of every PSD bin preserved; bulk concentration and bulk PSD unchanged
sediment_transport_v24_16.scope_limit: no finite-Re drag, explicit meridional CFD velocity field, wall resuspension/deposition kinetics, aggregation/fragmentation, sediment-flow feedback, or air-headspace re-entry

v24_16_sweep.purpose: isolate sediment redistribution from the V24.15 free-surface geometry
